sources.entry: Shifty - A macOS menu bar app that gives you more control over Night Shift. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/thompsonate/Shifty)

summary.name: Shifty
summary.one_liner: Shifty is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that adds control over the built-in Night Shift feature, such as per-app, per-website, and custom-schedule rules.
use_cases: Disable Night Shift for specific apps
Turn off Night Shift on certain websites
Set custom Night Shift time periods
Sync Dark Mode with Night Shift schedule
Toggle Night Shift with a keyboard shortcut
summary.what_it_does: Shifty extends macOS's built-in Night Shift by letting you disable it for specific apps, websites, and custom time periods. It provides quick access to a slider for adjusting color temperature. It includes a Quick Toggle for Night Shift, can set Dark Mode to follow the Night Shift schedule, and can make Night Shift rules also affect True Tone. Global keyboard shortcuts can be set for common actions.
notable: Per-app and per-website Night Shift rules, with website shifting supported in Safari, Chrome, Opera, and Vivaldi
Open source under GPLv3 with code on GitHub
Global keyboard shortcuts and Quick Toggle from the menu bar
Can link Night Shift schedule to Dark Mode and True Tone
caveats: Requires macOS 10.12.4 or later and a Mac that supports Night Shift
True Tone features require a supported Mac and macOS 10.14 or later
Website shifting only works in Safari, Chrome, Opera, and Vivaldi
